name: Summer Leadership Institute (paid mural apprentices)
city: Brooklyn, NY (murals across New York City)
what_you_do: Join a team of 15 to 20 youth and two teaching artists. You research a community issue, design a mural, and paint it with neighbors from July to August.
who_can_apply: Youth. Ages, grades and how to join are not stated on the program page.
pay_detail: The page says youth get stipends and calls it a summer jobs program. The amount is not stated.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the program page. Contact Groundswell: Office@groundswell.nyc or 718-254-9782 (shown on the site), or check the Youth section for application news.
notes: Confirm first. The page does not list ages, pay amount or how to apply. It says murals are made throughout New York City, and one project title mentions Queensbridge House.
